incident_control.single_flight: MonitoringLifecycleController admits one sample and coalesces overlapping requests into one follow-up.
incident_control.unclean_exit: A persisted in-progress marker causes the next launch to enter Safety Pause with retained evidence described as potentially stale.
incident_control.circuit_breaker: Resident memory, SQLite main/WAL/SHM bytes, and event backpressure are evaluated before traversal, after a scan slice, and after persistence/retention.
incident_control.retention_interlock: Retention does not run while a scan generation is partial. This prevents deletion of an active generation's referenced scope row.

bounded_diagnostics.filesystem_scope: Process and database-family metadata only; the diagnostic sampler never traverses watched roots.

evidence: Config/Packaging/project.yml sets ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX=NO for the direct-distribution app.
The existing disk-witness-mcp tool demonstrates a bundled, separately signed hardened-runtime helper pattern.
Watched roots are currently persisted as normalized paths, not security-scoped bookmark blobs.
helper_feasibility.decision: Keep the safety controls effective in-process now. Introduce a dedicated scanner helper only together with bounded traversal and explicit lifecycle/IPC supervision; do not claim isolation in this increment.

limitations: The legacy traversal algorithm still repeats directory listings; the 512-entry ceiling is containment, not the final scanner fix.
Resource sampling cannot preempt one blocking kernel filesystem call. Process isolation and traversal replacement remain required by TASK-302.
The 150 MiB production target is enforced, but its feasibility across representative installed workloads is not established until the scale gate.
